lines.japanese: 「くあぁ～あ……」
lines.english: “Hwaaaah...”

lines.japanese: 女を抱いた帰路、ファルコンは疲弊した体を引きずるように歩いていた。
lines.english: On his way home from taking a woman to bed, Falcon walked as though dragging his exhausted body behind him.

lines.japanese: 休日の昼中、まだ志気横溢な冬の太陽が睡眠不足のまぶたを刺している。彼は強がっているが、あちこち殴られ蹴られた身体が無事なわけはない。
lines.english: It was noon on a holiday, and the winter sun, still brimming with martial vigor, stabbed at his sleep-starved eyes. He put on a brave face, but a body beaten and kicked in a dozen places could hardly be unharmed.

lines.japanese: それでも小便くさい童女に発情して性器と性器を擦りあわせたファルコンは、脳内で多量に分泌されたエンドルフィンの余韻に浸っていた（エンドルフィンってなんだろう）。
lines.english: Even so, Falcon had become aroused by a little girl who still smelled of piss and rubbed their genitals together, and now basked in the afterglow of the endorphins flooding his brain. (What, incidentally, was an endorphin?)

lines.japanese: 受精を避ける生殖行為など本末転倒、私にはまったくの時間と体力の浪費に思えるが、我が愚弟はそこに何らかの意義を見出したのだろう。
lines.english: To engage in the reproductive act while deliberately avoiding reproduction struck me as a perfect inversion of ends and means—a sheer waste of time and vigor. Presumably my foolish brother discerned some significance in it.

lines.japanese: はるか闇の底での幽閉期間が長かった私には、実体を持つという感覚について（皆無ってわけじゃないんですけど）まだ不可解な部分が多い。知識というより、実地での経験が絶対的に不足しているのだ。
lines.english: My confinement in the farthest depths of darkness had endured so long that much about possessing a physical form remained mysterious to me. (Not that I was wholly without experience.) More than knowledge, what I lacked was practice.

lines.japanese: そうだ、経験だ。
lines.english: Yes. Experience.

lines.japanese: もし陽の当たる場所に出られたなら、私も射精をしてみようと思った。
lines.english: Should I ever emerge beneath the sun, I decided I should try ejaculating too.

lines.japanese: 漫然と歩きつづけるファルコンをよそに、私は射精のことや射精以外のことについて思索を巡らせていた。
lines.english: While Falcon trudged aimlessly onward, I pondered ejaculation, and matters other than ejaculation.
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: もし陽の当たる場所に出られたなら、射精をはじめ、するべきことが山とある。グレタガルドを奪還するのは言うまでもない。そのためには、先んじて潜入している我が軍の先遣部隊と合流する必要があるだろう。
lines.english: Should I ever emerge beneath the sun, there would be a mountain of things to do, beginning with ejaculation. The reconquest of Gretagard went without saying. To achieve it, I should first rendezvous with the advance force of my army, which had infiltrated ahead of me.

lines.japanese: それから先代の遺した心美しき姫、麗しのプリンセス・ダヴ、叶うならぜひあの方に目通りを願いたい（なぜなら私が生まれいずる折に授かった生涯の使命は、そういえば彼女の平安を守ることだったからです）。
lines.english: Then there was the kindhearted princess left behind by my predecessor, the beautiful Princess Dove. If possible, I very much wished for an audience with her. (For, now that I think of it, the lifelong mission bestowed upon me at birth was to preserve her peace.)

lines.japanese: だが欲を言えば、この沸々と煮えたつ誰かをやっつけてやりたいと思う気持ちを解放してやりたいものだ。どんまり堆積した憎悪と怨嗟を崩さねば、いかな私とて、ついには気が触れてしまうやもしれぬ。
lines.english: Yet if I may confess one further desire, I wished to unleash this simmering urge to give somebody a sound thrashing. Unless I broke apart the dense sediment of hatred and rancor, even I might eventually lose my mind.

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、そこの俯いて歩く若者？」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, you there—the young man with his head down?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 何者かに呼びとめられて、ファルコンはいかにも戦士らしい無骨な態度で振りかえった。さすがは腐っても暗黒街の王である。かつてはその眼力で、スラムのならず者たちをことごとく平伏させたという。
lines.english: Someone called to him, and Falcon turned with the rough manner befitting a warrior. Even fallen, he remained king of the underworld. It is said that once, the mere force of his gaze made every rogue in the slums kneel before him.

lines.japanese: 「お、っとォ」
lines.english: “Whoa there.”

lines.japanese: 例に漏れず、そいつも怯んだ。だが一瞬である。なかなか肝の据わった女だ。いいだろう、私がハレムを建設した際には側室のひとりとして篤く迎えいれてやる。
lines.english: Like all the others, she recoiled—but only for an instant. A woman of admirable nerve. Very well: when I build my harem, I shall receive her warmly as one of my consorts.

lines.japanese: 「恐いかお。なんか今日、別人みたい」
lines.english: “Scary face. You look like a different person today.”

lines.japanese: ハーレムナンバー００１は、馴れ馴れしく語りかけながらファルコンに近づいてきた。
lines.english: Harem Number 001 approached Falcon, addressing him with undue familiarity.
“Guh.”

lines.japanese: 今度はファルコンが怯んだ。彼は狼狽している。ただの街頭勧誘かと思った相手が、どうやら自分の姿を知っている者だったらしい。
lines.english: This time Falcon recoiled. He was plainly disconcerted. He had taken her for an ordinary street solicitor, but apparently she knew the face he wore.

lines.japanese: もちろん私には、それがホークの女であるとすぐに分かった。だが優秀な私と違い、愚弟ファルコンには≪世界の声≫を聴く力がない。ゆえに彼はその女を、交友関係の広いイーグルの関係者だと決めつけた。
lines.english: Naturally, I recognized her at once as Hawk's woman. Unlike my gifted self, however, foolish Falcon could not hear the *voices of the world*. He therefore decided she must be an acquaintance of the sociable Eagle.

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや……サーセン、自分ちょっと急いでますんで」
lines.english: “Uh, sorry. I’m kind of in a hurry.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで敬語？」
lines.english: “Why are you being so polite?”

lines.japanese: 「てか、どっから声出してんの？」
lines.english: “And where are you making that voice come from?”

lines.japanese: 「え……アまあ、いろいろ。そんじゃ」
lines.english: “Uh... Well, it's complicated. See you.”

lines.japanese: 物真似をあっさり見破られ、ファルコンはおもてを隠して逃げさろうとした。
lines.english: With his imitation seen through immediately, Falcon hid his face and tried to escape.

lines.japanese: 「えっ……あ、待って羽田君」
lines.english: “Wait... Haneda, hold on.”

lines.japanese: しかし００１は、聖騎士ホークの現在の名で彼を呼びとめた。ファルコンは「タカシかよ」と毒づきながら足を止め、なかば背を向けたまま、俯きがちに振りかえった。
lines.english: But 001 stopped him with the Holy Knight Hawk's present name. Muttering, *So it's Takashi*, Falcon halted and, still half turned away, looked back with his head lowered.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あー、えっと……どこ行くの？」
lines.english: “Oh, um... Where are you going?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと」
lines.english: “Somewhere.”

lines.japanese: ファルコンはホークと違う声を聞かせたくなくて、短い言葉を選んだ。
lines.english: Falcon chose as few words as possible, unwilling to let her hear a voice unlike Hawk’s.

lines.japanese: 「あ、言いたくないんだ。あーやしぃー」
lines.english: “Oh, you don't want to tell me? Suspi-cious.”

lines.japanese: 他愛のない冗談だろうが、怪しまれては困る。ファルコンは貧相な頭脳を絞って、ホークの行きそうな場所を考えた。
lines.english: It was surely only a harmless joke, but suspicion would be inconvenient. Falcon wrung his impoverished brain for somewhere Hawk might plausibly go.

lines.japanese: 「あー……ゲーム屋？」
lines.english: “Uh... The game store?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ああ、ぴこぴこ売ってるとこ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh—the place that sells all the beep-boop things?”

lines.japanese: 音量を絞ったファルコンの声が聞こえづらいようで、００１は前のめりに耳を近づけてきた。
lines.english: Falcon had lowered his voice so far that 001 could barely hear him. She leaned forward and brought her ear closer.

lines.japanese: 「なに買うの？」
lines.english: “What are you buying?”

lines.japanese: 「だから、ゲーム」
lines.english: “A game. I just said.”

lines.japanese: 「なんていう？」
lines.english: “What’s it called?”

lines.japanese: ホークと違い、ファルコンはその分野に疎かったようだ。答えに窮し、無意識に舌打ちしていた。女が面食らって上半身を引く。
lines.english: Unlike Hawk, Falcon appeared ignorant of the subject. At a loss for an answer, he clicked his tongue without realizing it. The woman flinched and drew back.

lines.japanese: ファルコンは煩わしさを覚え、おのれの後頭部を激しく掻きむしった。そうして乏しい知識から、比較的なじみのある固有名詞をひとつ探りあてた。
lines.english: Falcon grew irritated and raked violently at the back of his head. From his scant knowledge he dredged up one proper noun that was relatively familiar.

lines.japanese: 「ああアレ……ウイングクエストだ」
lines.english: “Oh, that one... *Wing Quest*.”

lines.japanese: 「へー？　なにそれ」
lines.english: “Oh? What’s that?”

lines.japanese: 「むかし流行ったロープレ。そんじゃ」
lines.english: “An RPG that was popular years ago. See you.”

lines.japanese: ファルコンは右手を上げるより先に駆けだした。まだなにか聞きだそうとする女の声が背後から追いすがっていたが、聞こえなかったことにして足を止めなかった。
lines.english: Falcon broke into a run before even raising a hand in farewell. The woman's voice pursued him from behind, still trying to ask something, but he pretended not to hear and never slowed.

lines.japanese: 「あらあら、逃げ足の速いこと」
lines.english: “My, my. Look at him run.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ。ほーんと、別人みたいだよね」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. He really does seem like a different person.”

lines.japanese: ００１はひとりごとを言っていた。ちょっと頭の弱い娘なのかもしれない。
lines.english: 001 was talking to herself. Perhaps the girl was a little dim.

lines.japanese: ようやく寝床へ辿りついたと思ったファルコンだったが、羽田邸の前で待ちぶせていた自走四輪車（教えてやろう、あれは自動車というものだ。単にクルマと呼ぶ場合もある）を目にして疲労の色をさらに強めた。
lines.english: Falcon thought he had finally reached his bed, only to find a self-propelled four-wheeled vehicle lying in wait before the Haneda residence. (Allow me to enlighten you: it is called an automobile. It may also be called simply a car.) The weariness on his face deepened.

lines.japanese: 「今度はあいつらかよ……いいかげん寝かせろ」
lines.english: “Now it's these assholes... Just let me sleep already.”

lines.japanese: ファルコンは小さく唇を上下させ、不吉な予感を音声として出力した。重いまぶたをこする。だいぶ日差しが眩しいようだ。
lines.english: Falcon faintly moved his lips, converting his sense of foreboding into audible speech. He rubbed his heavy eyelids. The sunlight was evidently far too bright.

lines.japanese: 「おかえり」
lines.english: “Welcome home.”

lines.japanese: 助手席から降りてきたのはフェニックスだった。運転席では、禿頭の大男がこちらに暴力的な笑顔を向けていた。
lines.english: Phoenix stepped out of the passenger seat. Behind the wheel, a massive bald man aimed a violent smile our way.

lines.japanese: 「ＹＯ、成田君！　どうしたんだいアンタ、その体はァ！　ひでえもんだな、泥まみれの傷まみれじゃねえか。その分じゃ大方、おケツの中は汁まみれってかい、ハッハー！」
lines.english: “Yo, Narita! What happened to you, man? You're a goddamn wreck—all mud and wounds. Looking like that, I bet your ass is full of juice too! Hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 大男は翼を広げるハゲタカのようにぼわさんぼわさんと笑ったが、ファルコンは微塵も笑いかえさなかった。露骨な欠伸で無礼な態度を強調しながら、彼らの自動車へ近づいてゆく。
lines.english: The giant's laughter went *bwoom, bwoom*, like a vulture spreading its wings, but Falcon gave him nothing in return. Advertising his contempt with an ostentatious yawn, he approached their automobile.

lines.japanese: 「あれえ、今日はシュウちゃんじゃないんだ？」
lines.english: “Huh? You're not Shu today?”

lines.japanese: 「っせえ、余計なこと言うな」
lines.english: “Shut up. Don't say shit you don't need to.”

lines.japanese: 愚弟は運転席のハゲタカを気にしながら、目の前で薄笑いを浮かべているフェニックスをひと睨みした。
lines.english: Mindful of the Vulture behind the wheel, my foolish brother glared at Phoenix, who stood before him wearing a thin smile.

lines.japanese: 「珍しいじゃん、おまえがこんな時間に。あはは、太陽と成田隼人。似合わねえー」
lines.english: “You at this hour? That's rare. Ahaha—the sun and Hayato Narita. You two really don't go together.”

lines.japanese: 「そらこっちの台詞だ。てめえこそ今日はこうじゃねーのか」
lines.english: “I could say the same to you. Isn't this more your usual look around now?”

lines.japanese: ファルコンは膝を落とし、腰より低い位置で怪鳥のように両腕を広げた。ぎょろりと目玉をひん剥き、わなわなと下顎を震わせる。だららん、なかなか似ているじゃあないか。
lines.english: Falcon bent his knees and spread both arms below his waist like some monstrous bird. His eyes bulged, and his lower jaw trembled violently. Dangle, dangle. A rather good likeness, in fact.

lines.japanese: 「だってこの時間だから、そっちはてっきりシュウちゃんで来ると思ったもん」
lines.english: “It's just, at this hour I was sure you'd show up as Shu.”

lines.japanese: 「つーか俺、ほら、アレここんとこ連用しすぎちゃったじゃん？　さすがに体ヤバいみたいでさあ。頭とか胸とかビミョーに痛むんだよね。物忘れ多くなったし、あー、あと、おしっこ変な色してた」
lines.english: “Besides, you know, I've been using that stuff way too much lately, right? Think my body's finally in trouble. My head and chest sort of hurt. I keep forgetting things, and—oh, yeah—my piss was a weird color.”

lines.japanese: 「自業自得。警察病院連れてかれる前に、ガキみてーな遊び卒業しとけ」
lines.english: “Your own damn fault. Grow out of your kiddie games before you end up in the police hospital.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、まあ、そのうちね。理論上では、いつかグロリアス抜きでも、あっちの人格出せるようになるはずなんだ」
lines.english: “Yeah, sure. Eventually. In theory, I should be able to bring out that other personality without Glorious someday.”

lines.japanese: 「だァら、オモんねーんだよ。俺の前でそういうクソな冗談言うんじゃねえ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “I told you, that shit isn't funny. Don't make garbage jokes like that in front of me or I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは。そっちこそ、ひとが文字通り命懸けてる真摯な願いをクソ呼ばわりしないでくれる？　すんげえムカつくから！」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Then could you stop calling the sincere wish I'm literally risking my life for garbage? It really pisses me off!”

lines.japanese: 話になんねえ。ファルコンは欠伸しながら呟いた。疲労と眠気が頭上に重くのしかかっている。彼は目やにを気にして目頭を掻きながら、禿頭の男ひとり残った自動車へ注意を向けた。
lines.english: *This is going nowhere,* Falcon muttered through a yawn. Exhaustion and sleep weighed heavily upon his head. Scratching at the corner of one eye, bothered by the grit there, he turned toward the automobile, where the bald man sat alone.

lines.japanese: ファルコンの脳裏を鬱陶しい長髪の男がかすめた。あれは……たしかフェニックスの従士だったか。泣きだしそうな顔をしている。
lines.english: An irritating long-haired man crossed Falcon's mind. He was... one of Phoenix's retainers, if memory served. He had looked ready to cry.

lines.japanese: 「鳳。森里は」
lines.english: “Otori. Where's Morisato?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　なんでよ。野に放したコウモリのその後なんか知らないよ。つーか俺に聞かなくても、隼人きのう、ヘテロであいつに会ったんでしょ？」
lines.english: “What? Why ask me? I don't know what happened to a bat we turned loose in the wild. Besides, you met him at Hetero yesterday, didn't you, Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、まー」
lines.english: “Uh. Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 俯いて目蓋をこする。ファルコンの思考は睡魔の侵攻によって、その機能が滞りはじめていた。それがゆえ、まあどうでもいいやと思った。投げやりである。
lines.english: He lowered his head and rubbed his eyelids. Under sleep's advancing invasion, Falcon's thoughts had begun to seize up. He decided it did not matter. Pure resignation.

lines.japanese: 「あーじゃー俺、帰って寝るんで。おやすみなさい」
lines.english: “Right, then. I'm going home to sleep. Good night.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、待てって。ちょっと。ねえ。実はアレもう、俺の耳に入ってんだけど」
lines.english: “No, no, wait. Hold on. Hey. I've actually heard about it already.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　なにが」
lines.english: “Huh? About what?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、ゴキブリ軍団とのいざこざ解決したんだって？　なら約束だよ、あの話の続きをするってね。はい、乗って」
lines.english: “You settled that mess with the cockroach army, didn't you? Then we had a deal: we'd continue that conversation. Come on, get in.”

lines.japanese: 「やだよ。俺もう疲れてんだよ、ちょお眠みーんだよ」
lines.english: “Don't wanna. I'm exhausted. I'm so fucking sleepy.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、勘違いすんなって。これ命令。そっちに決定権なんかァ、ね・え・の♪」
lines.english: “Ahaha, don’t get the wrong idea. This is an order. You. Don’t. Get. A. Say♪”

lines.japanese: フェニックスがゆらりと右手を伸ばした。ファルコンは溜息をこぼしたが、それを避けはしなかった。抵抗することもなく素直に首を捕まれ、そのままドアの開いた後部席に放りこまれる。
lines.english: Phoenix slowly extended his right hand. Falcon sighed but made no attempt to evade it. Without resistance, he let Phoenix seize him by the neck and toss him through the open door into the back seat.

lines.japanese: 「ちっ」
lines.english: “Tch.”

lines.japanese: 彼は合皮のシートに尻から着地して舌打ちした。フェニックスも助手席に戻る。
lines.english: He landed ass-first on the imitation-leather seat and clicked his tongue. Phoenix returned to the passenger seat.

lines.japanese: 「ようこそ血まみれのお客さん」
lines.english: “Welcome aboard, my blood-soaked guest.”

lines.japanese: 運転席のハゲタカが、座席の左脇の棒を手前へ引いた。自動車がぐぶんと一回身震いした。
lines.english: The Vulture behind the wheel pulled the lever to the left of his seat toward him. The automobile gave a single shuddering thrum.

lines.japanese: 「あんたの一声さえありゃあ、俺はもちろん地の果てまでも目指してやるが、差しあたり今日のところはどこの風をお求めだいブラッディエンジェル」
lines.english: “Say the word and I'll drive you to the ends of the earth, naturally—but for today, what wind are you chasing, Bloody Angel?”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、どうせ俺に決定権はねーんだろ」
lines.english: “Shut up. I don’t get a say anyway, do I?”

lines.japanese: ファルコンはぶっきらぼうに答えて靴を脱ぎすてた。窮屈な体勢で股を広げ、むりやり仰向けになる。まな板の上のハヤブサだ。
lines.english: Falcon answered curtly and kicked off his shoes. He spread his legs in the cramped space and forced himself onto his back. A falcon laid out on the butcher's block.

lines.japanese: 「うーん……じゃあヘテロでいい？　それとも、なんかどっか美味い飯でも食える店にする？」
lines.english: “Hmm... Hetero, then? Or should we find someplace with decent food?”

lines.japanese: 「どこでもいいっつの、好きにしろ。俺ァちょっと横ンなる」
lines.english: “Told you I don't care. Do what you want. I'm lying down for a minute.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、なにこいつ、偉っそうだなあ。おォい、寝るなよ」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Get a load of him, acting all high and mighty. Hey, don’t fall asleep.”

lines.japanese: 「寝ねーよ」
lines.english: “I won’t.”

lines.japanese: しかし、言いながらもファルコンは危惧していた。眠ってるあいだにタカシが≪コックピット≫へ入ってしまったらどうしよう。あいつは鳳と面識がないんじゃないのか。また驚いてグレタガルドへ逃げるのだろうか。
lines.english: Yet even as he said it, Falcon was worried. What if Takashi entered the *Cockpit* while he slept? Takashi had never met Otori, had he? Would the shock send him fleeing to Gretagard again?

lines.japanese: 「ぜってー……寝ねーっつの……」
lines.english: “I'm telling you... I'm not gonna sleep...”

lines.japanese: しかし、いよいよ睡魔が強引に彼の目を閉ざし、その意識を吸いとりはじめた。
lines.english: But sleep finally forced his eyes shut and began siphoning away his consciousness.

lines.japanese: 不自然に体を曲げた姿勢は全身の怪我にこたえるが、それすらもサンドマンの撒きちらす魔法の粉がごとき眠気には及ばなかった。
lines.english: His body was bent at an unnatural angle, aggravating every injury, yet even that discomfort was no match for the drowsiness scattered like the Sandman's magic dust.

lines.japanese: 呼吸はもはや寝息に近い。ゆるやかに上下する胸板。
lines.english: His breathing had nearly settled into sleep. His chest rose and fell in a gentle rhythm.

lines.japanese: 彼がまどろみをさまよっているあいだ、私は込みあげてくる強烈な嗤いを懸命に抑えていた。
lines.english: While he wandered the borderlands of slumber, I fought desperately to suppress the tremendous laughter welling within me.

lines.japanese: ぷ……ぷぷ、ぷっ……！
lines.english: Pff... pff-heh, pff...!

lines.japanese: ファルコンはもはや完全に私を奈落の底へ追いかえしたと思っている（可哀想な愚弟。彼は偉大なる王がすぐそばに伏しているなんて、夢にも思っていないのです！）。
lines.english: Falcon believed he had driven me all the way back to the floor of the abyss. (My poor foolish brother. Never did he dream that the great king lay in wait so very near!)

lines.japanese: 眠りに落ちてゆく僭主。息を潜めて待つ国王。
lines.english: The usurper sinking into sleep. The king holding his breath and waiting.

lines.japanese: 落ちてゆく。落ちてゆく。落ちてゆく。
lines.english: Falling. Falling. Falling.

lines.japanese: お・ち・て・ゆ・く！
lines.english: Down. He. Goes!

lines.japanese: そして……ついに≪コックピット≫は無人になった。
lines.english: And then... at last, the *Cockpit* stood empty.

lines.japanese: ぬなり。
lines.english: Slllip.

lines.japanese: 私は井戸から這いでる魔物がごとく、闇の中から光の外へ、頭を、腕を、胴を──そして、脚を、出だだだだだすすすすすうううううう！！！！！
lines.english: Like a monster crawling from a well, I emerged from darkness into light—head, arms, torso, and then my legs, o-o-o-o-out I co-co-co-co-coooooome!!!!!

lines.japanese: 燦然と輝く地上の光が、しゃいんしゃいんと痛いぐらいに全身を撃った。
lines.english: The dazzling light of the surface struck my whole body, shine-shine, almost painfully bright.

lines.japanese: ひ、光！（しゃいんしゃいん、しゃいんしゃいん）
lines.english: L-light! (Shine-shine, shine-shine.)

lines.japanese: ひひひひ光がッ！　ここここここの体に！（しゃいんしゃいん、しゃいんしゃいん）
lines.english: L-l-l-light! On th-th-th-this body! (Shine-shine, shine-shine.)

lines.japanese: ふ・り・そ・そ・ぐ！
lines.english: It. Pours. Down!

lines.japanese: 「っ……ぷふっ」
浴びせられる快感。もはや私には嗤いを押しころすことが不可能だった。（しゃいんしゃいん）
lines.english: Pleasure poured over me. Suppressing my laughter had become impossible. (Shine-shine.)

lines.japanese: 「ぷ、くく、うぷぷぷ……！」
lines.english: “Pff, heh heh, ohohoho...!”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　なんだよ隼人、キメえ笑い方すんなよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What the hell, Hayato? Don't laugh like a creep.”

lines.japanese: フェニックスが応えた。素晴らしい。私の嗤いは彼に──外の世界に発信されているではないか！
lines.english: Phoenix answered. Magnificent. My laughter was being transmitted to him—to the world outside!

lines.japanese: サン・シャイィィィーン！
lines.english: Sun-shiiiiine!

lines.japanese: 「てかおまえー、寝んじゃなかったのー？」
lines.english: “Hey, weren't you the one who said you weren't gonna sleep?”

lines.japanese: 私は横たわったままゆっくり目蓋を開けた。生の五感に押しよせてくるリアルの色彩、声音、温度、そして重力の付加。すべてが懐かしく、すべてが歓びで、すべてが心地良い。
lines.english: Still lying down, I slowly opened my eyes. Colors, voices, temperature—and the added weight of gravity—flooded my five living senses. Everything was familiar. Everything was joy. Everything felt exquisite.

lines.japanese: 「クク……眠るだと？　馬鹿を申すな。俺はいま目覚めたばかりだ」
lines.english: “Heh heh... Sleep, you say? Speak no foolishness. I have only just awakened.”

lines.japanese: 助手席からフェニックスが体ごと振りかえった。私はまだ四肢の操作に慣れず身を起こせなかったが、二度三度まばたきをしてから眼球だけを彼の方へ移動させた。
lines.english: Phoenix twisted his whole body around from the passenger seat. Still unused to commanding my limbs, I could not sit up. After blinking two or three times, I shifted only my eyes toward him.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ……まさか……」
lines.english: “You... Don't tell me...”

lines.japanese: 「久しいな、親愛なるフェニックス。蹴爪は研いでいたか？」
lines.english: “It has been too long, dear Phoenix. Have you kept your talons sharp?”

lines.japanese: 「伽楼羅ッ！？」
lines.english: “Karura?!”

lines.japanese: 「しかり。余こそグレタガルドの正当なる王位後継者ガルーダ・ダークブラック。またの名を伊丹伽楼羅」
lines.english: “Indeed. We are Garuda Darkblack, rightful heir to the throne of Gretagard. Also known as Karura Itami.”

lines.japanese: 「栄えある王の凱旋だ。兵を集めよフェニックス、奈落の名に懸けて、我らが故郷を再興せん」
lines.english: “The king returns in glory. Muster the troops, Phoenix. By the Abyss, we shall restore our homeland.”
